meta.source: Onside demo prototype (Highlighter direction), CSS custom properties

tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page and slide background. Warm off-white, never pure white behind content.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, dialogs, table bodies.

tokens.name: surface-soft
tokens.usage: Table headers, secondary cards, sub-bars.

tokens.name: sunk
tokens.usage: Avatars, neutral pills, Helper reply bubbles.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines, card borders, table rules.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input borders, secondary button borders, dashed empty slots.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on ground, surface and highlighter. Primary button fill. Marks independent work (no AI).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions and labels on ground or surface.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Decorative only (disabled icons, dashed outlines). Not for text.

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an ink fill (primary button, student chat bubble).

tokens.name: highlighter
tokens.usage: The signature colour. Hints, AI-supported work, and the marker stroke under one key phrase. Text on it is ink.

tokens.name: highlighter-line
tokens.usage: Border of highlighter cards and chips.

tokens.name: highlighter-ink
tokens.usage: Small labels on highlighter ("Hint 1 of 2") and on ground next to highlighter marks.

tokens.name: pink
tokens.usage: Tutor-side primary action (Create review quiz, Send to Mina). Text on it is ink. One per screen.

tokens.name: pink-soft
tokens.usage: Background of wrong-answer feedback and "Why this question" notes.

tokens.name: pink-ink
tokens.usage: Text on pink-soft.

tokens.name: status-needs
tokens.usage: "Needs work" status icon and label on surface. Always with the triangle icon.

tokens.name: status-needs-soft
tokens.usage: "Needs review" pill background.

tokens.name: status-shaky
tokens.usage: "Shaky" status icon and label on surface. Always with the half-filled circle.

tokens.name: status-solid
tokens.usage: "Solid" status icon and label, correct-answer marks, on surface.

tokens.name: status-solid-soft
tokens.usage: "Correct" pill and correct-answer feedback background.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps, pip gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Chip and button gaps.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Stack gap inside panels.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on small cards; minimum side gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding, page gutters, gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Hero card padding, space above page titles.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, question boxes (Q1–Q4).

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Feedback banners, score cards, small cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Main cards and panels.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Pills, chips, avatars.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Cards on the ground. Drawers and dialogs use a larger version; nothing else casts a shadow.
